anchor/case.note: the case a `collect` objective is filled from

anchor/counter.note: the shop affordance. Three blocks EAST of the stall: clear of the vendor body (DW0359), and standing where the critical path already looks, so the POV shot that ends at the counter frames something the campaign declares instead of empty floor

anchor/east-bay.note: the second volume, so a pair of region verbs never share a box

anchor/east-pit.note: the second killing volume, so the two never share a box

anchor/east-vault.note: the stone canopy a `collapse` brings down onto the east bay floor

anchor/exit.note: the finale: the last thing a player reaches

anchor/gate-main.note: the long way through, off in the west corner: opened by quest progress

anchor/hearth.note: the respawn point — a bonfire and a plain checkpoint alike

anchor/lane-east.note: the other end of the patrol lane

anchor/lane-west.note: one end of the patrol lane — 20 blocks from its partner, because a leg under 12 is one vanilla re-rolls off the lane (DW0386)

anchor/lectern.note: the speaking part: dialogue, barks, the cast ledger

anchor/march.note: the far end of a lane's march

anchor/muster.note: where a wave is seated and a lane begins

anchor/pedestal.note: the thing a player presses: interact objectives and click triggers

anchor/pocket.note: inside the barrier pocket. Its only way in is the full-cube course in the wall line, so a body that walks here has crossed a line its species is not allowed through — which is the whole of what a `traversal` declaration answers. Off the critical path on purpose: blocking geometry on the route makes the build's render plan and the one `snapshot` derives disagree

anchor/rafters.note: where the ambush stages, 24 blocks from the hearth because a body inside a respawn point's aggro radius is DW0478

anchor/shortcut-door.note: the souls shortcut: dead ahead of spawn, barred until it is unlocked from the far side — which is what makes opening it SHORTEN the walk (DW0374), where a second door beside the long one would not

anchor/stall.note: the shop counter: offers, stakes, forfeits

anchor/timed-door.note: the gate on a clock: opens and re-seals on its own cycle

anchor/vantage.note: where a camera stands to look back down the hall

anchor/warden.note: the second speaking part, so a root SWAP has somewhere to go

anchor/west-bay.note: a room-sized volume: lethal boxes, teleport boxes, region edits

anchor/west-pit.note: a killing volume with nothing posted in it (DW0511)
